concerns.text: Task T006 is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but writes to `data/fallbacks.log`, which is also written by Task T007 via `handle_fallback`. This shared mutable log creates a hidden race condition if the two tasks are executed in parallel, violating the parallel‑safety guarantee.

Task T007 is also tagged `[P]` yet reads and writes the same `data/fallbacks.log` used by T006. Because both tasks may modify the file concurrently, the `[P]` tag is unsafe and should be removed or the tasks should use distinct log files.
